[Intro: Bright accordion and pizzicato strings, soft wind chimes]

[Verse 1]
Red shoes on wet earth
a hat full of wind and salt
he doesn't ask where the map begins
because the river teaches him to ford

[Verse 2]
They shout "Beware of the precipice!"
but he smiles without ever stopping
his backpack smells of freshly cut grass
and of promises no one made him keep

[Chorus]
THE PATH IS BORN WHERE I PLACE MY FOOT!
THERE IS NO TOMORROW THAT CAN STOP ME!
The only certainty is this moment
and the sun that follows me out of curiosity

[Inst: Lively accordion solo with light string plucks and distant flute echoes]

[Verse 3]
He carries no watch, counts no coins
he only keeps a flower between his fingers
the whole world fits in his laughter
as he jumps over the pebbles of yesterday

[Chorus]
THE PATH IS BORN WHERE I PLACE MY FOOT!
THERE IS NO TOMORROW THAT CAN STOP ME!
The only certainty is this moment
and the sun that follows me out of curiosity

[Bridge: Strings swell gently, accordion shifts to sparse single notes]
Perhaps I will fall, perhaps I will fly
perhaps the path will disappear as I pass
but today I am zero and everything is possible
like the first breath of the universe

[Chorus]
THE PATH IS BORN WHERE I PLACE MY FOOT!
THERE IS NO TOMORROW THAT CAN STOP ME!
The only certainty is this moment
and the sun that follows me out of curiosity

[Outro: Accordion and strings fade slowly with soft breeze sounds]

zero steps… zero fears… infinity ahead….
